title: AstroCare_X02_BaselineOutput
description: Frozen X02 per-astronaut Bayesian baseline output contract for ML2 and BE1 consumers.

metric.description: Metric registry identifier (e.g. heart_rate, glucose, sleep_hours)

mean.description: Predictive state mean in metric native units

lo90.description: Lower bound of nominal 90% predictive interval in native units

hi90.description: Upper bound of nominal 90% predictive interval in native units

p_deviation.description: Predictive probability that metric is outside personal tolerance bounds

p10.description: 10th percentile minutes until critical threshold crossing
